title: Rafa On Chase Bridge
style: Drift phonk with a slowed mansion-club pulse that flips from 85 BPM half-time into 170 BPM double-time; verse rides grimy and minimal, then a tempo-shift edit snaps into a harder run. Piano trance stabs and choir pads bloom in the pre-chorus, chorus slams with distorted 808 slides and chopped lead vocal doubles. Main vocal stays close-mic and clipped, with stacked ad-libs and brief filtered throws. Ear candy includes reversed swells, tire-screech risers, and a sudden bass-drop switch. Mix is dark, wide, and car-POV loud., trance, latin
lyrics:
[Intro]
En la curva, mami
Rafa en el asiento
Mirando Chase Bridge
Ya cambió el tiempo

[Verse 1]
Low glide, blackout window
Hands steady on the wheel
Chrome bite on the pavement
I know the way feels real
Rafa got the cold stare
Eyes on the long escape
Bass in the chest like thunder
We ghost through the scrape
Two-loop life, one motion
Same turn, new flame
If they ask who’s running
Say my name

[Pre-Chorus]
Piano stab, then the hush
Choir up in the air
One breath, then the switch flips
Whole night somewhere else
Hold tight, don’t blink now
We gone in a spark
Bridge in the rearview
And I’m already in the dark

[Chorus]
Rafa the rapper
Rafa the rapper
Chase Bridge, chase Bridge
We make it bend
Rafa the rapper
Rafa the rapper
One more run
Then we do it again

[Verse 2]
Double-time tongue, I’m sliding
Fast when the cut comes in
Same face, new angle
Watch the whole scene spin
Mansion club slow sway
Then the floor gets mean
I was built for the chase lane
You know what I mean
Tires sing on the corner
Smoke in the backseat air
If the night wants pressure
I’m already there

[Pre-Chorus]
Piano stab, then the hush
Choir up in the air
One breath, then the switch flips
Whole night somewhere else
Hold tight, don’t blink now
We gone in a spark
Bridge in the rearview
And I’m already in the dark

[Chorus]
Rafa the rapper
Rafa the rapper
Chase Bridge, chase Bridge
We make it bend
Rafa the rapper
Rafa the rapper
One more run
Then we do it again

[Bridge]
Tempo tears in half
Then it jumps back high
Cold steel in the sub
And the world goes by
Rafa, rafa
Call it what you want
I was made for the bend
I was made for the stomp

[Final Chorus]
Rafa the rapper
Rafa the rapper
Chase Bridge, chase Bridge
We make it bend
Rafa the rapper
Rafa the rapper
One more run
Then we do it again
Rafa the rapper
Rafa the rapper
Late-night king
Till the road’s own end
